Questions, answered

Boulder team building FAQs

Which company does corporate team building in Boulder? +

Legendary Team Building provides corporate, executive and charity team building in Boulder for groups of 5 to 5,000. We bring our signature give-back builds — bikes, skateboards and shoes donated to local kids — to your Boulder venue, and average 4.76/5 across 25,000+ participants since 2003.

Do you offer charity team building in Boulder? +

Yes — charity team building is our specialty. Every event we run in Boulder is built around giving back: your team assembles bikes, skateboards or shoes that are donated to local children in need, so a single event delivers both team building and real community impact.

Can you run large group team building in Boulder? +

Yes. We produce large group team building in Boulder for up to 5,000 people, including conference general sessions, with the same give-back builds we run for small teams. We handle the logistics at any scale.

What activities do you offer in Boulder? +

Our signature give-back activities — bike builds (Building a Dream), skateboard builds (Get On Board) and shoe builds (Sole Purpose) — for groups from 5 to 5,000. Every build is donated to children in the Boulder community.

Do you travel to Boulder and the Front Range? +

Yes. We bring everything to your location in Boulder and along the Front Range — downtown hotels, corporate campuses and foothill retreats. You provide the room; we handle the rest.

How large a group can you handle in Boulder? +

From 5 to 5,000 people, including conference general sessions. We’ve produced events at world-record scale, and teams we’ve guided have built more than 50,000 bikes for children since 2003.

How much does team building in Boulder cost? +

Pricing depends on group size, the activity and your venue. Most programs are priced per participant with the charitable donation included. Book a call and we'll send a tailored proposal.
